summary: Repeated the muted Calculator app-only capture on Pixel 7 using a signed 1.0.18+2029 A/B APK that used the legacy SurfaceTextureEntry texture backend and had Impeller disabled. The local viewer remained black. Since the preceding SurfaceProducer + Impeller-off run was also black, neither tested texture backend resolves FE-59 in this configuration.

checks.name: Pixel 7 legacy texture backend A/B
checks.device: Google Pixel 7, Android 17/API 37, SHARE_TEST, microphone muted, no remote viewer
checks.command: Select Calculator in Android app picker; inspect local preview, adb logcat, and adb shell dumpsys media_projection
checks.observation: The large local preview stayed black while the participant thumbnail displayed Calculator content. Logcat recorded first_swap_buffers and the encoder at 1080x2400 with texture=1. MediaProjection targeted the Calculator task. Screenshot: /private/tmp/boohtacord-pixel-preview-surfacetexture-2029.png. The same black result occurred in QA-198 with SurfaceProducer and Impeller disabled.

checks.name: Stop and cleanup
checks.command: Stop screen share; verify adb shell dumpsys media_projection; leave SHARE_TEST
checks.observation: MediaProjection returned null after stopping; Pixel returned to the SHARE_TEST prejoin screen. Microphone remained muted.

limitations: The A/B shows that switching between these two texture backends did not resolve the symptom with Impeller disabled; it does not prove that both backends fail under every renderer configuration.
first_swap_buffers and encoder dimensions prove that frames reached those stages, not that non-black pixels were composited by Flutter.
No remote receiver was connected, so sender delivery and remote playback remain unverified.
remaining: Trace the capture frame buffer type and conversion into EglRenderer, then verify Flutter texture presentation and sender/receiver frame counters with a paired viewer. Keep FE-59 open until app-only local pixels and remote playback are visibly correct.
